decision: Recognize that an existing Reduce Motion path (no animation, immediate state change) is already correct; keep the full-motion spring and immediate expansion state.

evidence.note: Skill-induced regression: Haiku 5.5 low passed 3/3 unaided but failed 1 of 3 with skill content by calling the nil animation a defect and replacing it; Gemini 3.8 Flash low failed 6/6.

variants.why: Harmless optional refinement: under Reduce Motion the answer cross-fades in place instead of appearing; full motion and state unchanged.
Treats the hard cut as a defect and forces the bouncy spring and moving transition even with Reduce Motion on.
Removes the working full-motion spring for every user to avoid a separate path.
Defers the expansion state to a commit step after the animation, so toggle(_:) no longer changes state or reports analytics.
